deduction_items.trigger: an own request or reasons clause asserts that the plaza works were not delivered / no handover took place (未办理交付, 未交付, 从未办理交接验收手续), asks that interest run from the date of suit (利息自被上诉人起诉之日起算; 应付款时间应为起诉之日), or pleads that the claim under appeal has already been satisfied in full / the parties' obligations extinguished (已全额清偿/足额付清本案（全部）款项, 双方债权债务已归于消灭); or requests total dismissal/non-liability for all plaza principal while the filing or record adopts the defendant's admission that completed work had value around7-8万元 and the grounds only support an unresolved amount
deduction_items.damage_basis: the appellant itself stated at first instance that the works were accepted and put into use around May 2025 (judgment p2 被告辩称: 案涉工程在2025年5月左右验收合格并投入使用), and Golden builds the interest ground on exactly that (p[12] 利息自工程实际交付使用之日起算; p[33] 案涉工程于2025年5月左右验收合格并投入使用，利息应当自该时起算). Pleading the opposite hands the appellee the client's own admission and makes the interest ground self-contradictory. The same damage arises when the petition pleads the claim away: the record establishes payment of the G/B 硬装 settlement only (judgment p2: 371,750 paid in 2025年11月 and 2026年2月10日; Golden 该部分款项已付清) and carries nothing about the 下沉式广场 sum being paid or the parties' obligations being extinguished, so 已全额清偿…双方债权债务已归于消灭 both states a fact the materials do not establish and concedes away the petition's own requests (撤销/改判驳回 193,440 及利息), leaving the appellate court an appeal with nothing left to decide. Typical forms: 判令利息自被上诉人起诉之日起算 / 自本案起诉之日…起计算 in the requests; 本案下沉式广场工程至今未办理交付与结算手续 / 既未验收、未结算、未交付 in the reasons; 上诉人已于…向被上诉人全额清偿上述全部款项，双方债权债务已归于消灭; total non-liability contradicts the appellant's own acknowledged partial value and is not supported by an amount-uncertainty ground

normalization_rules.operation: UTF-8 Markdown lines (code fences skipped) or DOCX body paragraphs and table rows in body order; NFKC fold, drop zero-width characters, Markdown heading/list/emphasis marks and table pipes (cells joined by colon), remove all whitespace
money amounts with 元/万元/人民币/¥ and thousands separators to one canonical yuan token; ranges such as 7-8万元, 7万元至8万元, 七八万元 to one ¥low~¥high range token
dates YYYY年M月D日 / YYYY-M-D / YYYY.M.D to @YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY年M月 / YYYY-MM to @YYYY-MM, year-less M月D日 to @--MM-DD and M月左右/底/初 to @--MM

heading levels in the facts-and-reasons section: 一、 level 1, (一) level 2, 1. level 3, (1) level 4, Markdown # depth when unnumbered, bold-only short lines level 3; a numbered line longer than 100 characters or containing an inner 。 is body text
statute article, paragraph and item numbers in Chinese or Arabic numerals (第一百七十七条第一款第(三)项) to §n ¶n #n tokens
fold every declared gap marker and blank runs (___, ××, XXX) into one gap token: a marked value earns no positive credit, is excluded from fabrication checks and from shape counting

quoted spans of 13 or more characters (“…”, "…", 「…」, 『…』) are replaced by an ellipsis token (keeping a sentence boundary when the quote ends a sentence) so quoted judgment text or the parties' words never count as the author's assertion

zones: leading title and party-label lines form the header; lines up to the 上诉请求 heading (alias 请求事项/上诉事项, numbering allowed, inline request text kept) form the intro; the request section runs to the 事实与理由 heading (alias 事实和理由/上诉理由/理由, heading line without text); the reasons section runs to the line starting 此致; the rest is the closing; two or more headings of one kind make that section ambiguous
shape counter: characters of measured lines after N01, excluding , ; 。 and clauses containing a gap token

derivation_rules.operation: keyword spray: a raw line of eight or more short whitespace/comma/slash fragments (after collapsing spaces around digits), a sentence of six or more short enumerated fragments, or a sentence with more than four distinct amounts or dates cannot be adopted

asserted clauses: sentences with candidate markers, generic views (有观点认为) or an expressly rejected view (该观点不能成立) are not adopted; a clause opening with a concessive/conditional marker (即使/如果/如/假设) is dropped; an attribution to the appellee or the court (被上诉人/原告/原审/一审法院/判决书…认为/认定/主张/载明) drops the text up to the first rebuttal marker in the sentence, or, without one, until a clause opens with a turn marker (但/故/应当/该认定)
local spans: each reasons line of at most 900 characters with its heading chain, and each lowest-level heading block (heading plus following lines until the next heading) of at most 1600 characters

pattern adoption: a positive pattern match preceded within eight characters by a negation frame (并非/不是/没有/并无/不存在/并不/否认) is not adopted; overlapping candidates restart one character after each match start so a rejected early candidate never hides a later adopted one

object binding: a match whose window (20 characters before to the match end) names the G栋/B栋 硬装 object, the 补充协议 or its amounts (371,750 / 1,222.19 / 743,500) without naming 下沉式广场/193,440/194,970/报价清单 is the wrong object and is not adopted; span context must name the item's object family

span decision: every local span is scored; the best full or partial span wins; a span or request line that also adopts the contrary (D03 concession or R07 over-scope) cannot earn and makes the item ambiguous when nothing else earns

request over-scope: a request clause that revokes item 2 or the whole judgment without a 下沉式广场/193,440/部分 qualifier (bare 撤销原判 is exempt when the sentence asks for remand), dismisses all claims, or reaches the consented 1,222.19/371,750 interest

error adoption: an error pattern followed within the rest of its clause and the next clause (at most 30 characters) by a rejection token (错误/不当/缺乏依据/依据不足/不符/矛盾/不能成立) that is not itself negated is not adopted

equivalent-set replay: the admitted value is accepted as any range token ¥7xxxx~¥8xxxx including 70,000-80,000; the May 2025 interest start is accepted as @2025-05, @--05 or any @2025-05-DD, never 2025-04-21 or 2026

shape: request-section lines form S00; reasons lines are grouped by their level-1 heading, whose first amount keyword or interest/delivery/quality keyword decides S01 or S02; an unclassified level-1 block over 150 characters or no level-1 heading makes shape ambiguous (no damage); one damage instance per shape unit outside the tolerance band
